topic: Salt dancing on a phone speaker
hook: Your phone speaker can make salt dance.
title: Make Salt Dance on Your Phone Speaker
description:
Lay your phone flat, stretch cling film over the speaker, sprinkle salt and play bass-heavy music. The grains jump and shift because sound is vibration. Works with any phone speaker.

#Shorts #PhoneTricks #Science
comment_prompt: Did the salt move? Yes or no
